info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Travel Expense Management API
info.description: The Travel Expense Management API enables organizations to efficiently update and manage employee travel expense reports. Utilizing this endpoint, financial and human resources teams can modify existing entries to reflect changes in employee travel expenditures. This is particularly beneficial for managing reimbursements, tracking company spending on travel, and ensuring compliance with corporate policies. Typical users include finance professionals, HR staff, and travel administrators who rely on real-time data for budgeting and reporting. Enhance your travel budgeting processes by seamlessly updating expense data with this API.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details for a specific travel expense identified by the unique resource ID. Modify relevant fields as necessary to keep the records accurate and up-to-date.

requestBody.description: Updates travel expense details for a specific resource. This request body should contain the necessary fields to modify the existing travel expense record identified by RES-100045.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the travel expenses were updated.
